descriptor: a lean thing on four legs, keeping low
notes: The common roamer. Alone it is an inconvenience; the point is that they are never alone. Aggro is deliberately longer than the spawn clearance: they cross open ground towards you, which is visible and avoidable, rather than lurking until stepped on. ⚠ No art: every character in the ingested packs is a biped on the Unreal rig, and this is described as an animal. Left on the appearance seed rather than drawn as a goblin (D-594).
